verdict.rationale: Box documents an event feed that apps can subscribe to for user or enterprise actions, with multiple stream types for real-time monitoring or historical queries. That is a change-feed mechanism rather than a full re-crawl, but the evidence never describes a cursor or stream-position parameter that returns only changes since the last call. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of cursor/stream-position semantics for incremental polling, detail on what change data is returned (file/folder deltas vs. audit events), retention and replay guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration of efficient delta sync.
